129 /* Function to compare two elements for qsort */
130 static int compare(const void *a, const void *b) {
131  Element *element1 = (Element *)a;
132  Element *element2 = (Element *)b;
133  return element1->value - element2->value;
134 }

151 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLISensorStart (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
152 {
153  bool doReconfig = true;
154  int32_t retVal = 0;
155 
156  /* Only following command syntax will be supported
157  sensorStart (for first time senor start)
158  sensorStart 0 (for sensor re-start)
159  */
160  if ((gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_INIT) && (argc == 1))
161  {
162  /* During first sensorStart, configuration should be done */
163  doReconfig = true;
164  }
165  else if((gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_STOPPED) && (argc == 2))
166  {
167  doReconfig = (bool) atoi (argv[1]);
168 
169  if (doReconfig == true)
170  {
171  CLI_write ("Error: Reconfig is not supported, only argument of 0 is\n"
172  "(do not reconfig, just re-start the sensor) valid\n");
173  return -1;
174  }
175  }
176  else
177  {
178  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid Sensor Start. \n");
179  return -1;
180  }
181 
182  /***********************************************************************************
183  * Spread SPectrum Configuration
184  ***********************************************************************************/
185  MMWDemo_configSSC();
186 
187  /***********************************************************************************
188  * Do sensor state management to influence the sensor actions
189  ***********************************************************************************/
190 
191  /* Error checking initial state: no partial config is allowed
192  until the first sucessful sensor start state */
193  if ((gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_INIT) ||
194  (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_OPENED))
195  {
196  MMWave_CtrlCfg ctrlCfg;
197 
198  /* need to get number of sub-frames so that next function to check
199  * pending state can work */
200  CLI_getMMWaveExtensionConfig (&ctrlCfg);
201  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames =
202  MmwDemo_RFParser_getNumSubFrames(&ctrlCfg);
203 
204  }
205 
206  if (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_STARTED)
207  {
208  CLI_write ("Ignored: Sensor is already started\n");
209  return 0;
210  }
211  else
212  {
213  /* User intends to issue sensor start with full config, check if all config
214  was issued after stop and generate error if is the case. */
215  MMWave_CtrlCfg ctrlCfg;
216 
217  /* need to get number of sub-frames so that next function to check
218  * pending state can work */
219  CLI_getMMWaveExtensionConfig (&ctrlCfg);
220  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames =
221  MmwDemo_RFParser_getNumSubFrames(&ctrlCfg);
222  }
223 
224  /***********************************************************************************
225  * Retreive and check mmwave Open related config before calling openSensor
226  ***********************************************************************************/
227 
228  /* Fill demo's MCB mmWave openCfg structure from the CLI configs*/
229  if (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_INIT)
230  {
231  /* Get the open configuration: */
232  CLI_getMMWaveExtensionOpenConfig (&gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg);
233  /* call sensor open */
234  retVal = MmwDemo_openSensor(true);
235  if(retVal != 0)
236  {
237  return -1;
238  }
239  gMmwMssMCB.sensorState = MmwDemo_SensorState_OPENED;
240  }
241  else
242  {
243  /* openCfg related configurations like chCfg, lowPowerMode, adcCfg
244  * are only used on the first sensor start. If they are different
245  * on a subsequent sensor start, then generate a fatal error
246  * so the user does not think that the new (changed) configuration
247  * takes effect, the board needs to be reboot for the new
248  * configuration to be applied.
249  */
250  MMWave_OpenCfg openCfg;
251  CLI_getMMWaveExtensionOpenConfig (&openCfg);
252  /* Compare openCfg->chCfg*/
253  if(memcmp((void *)&gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.chCfg, (void *)&openCfg.chCfg,
254  sizeof(rlChanCfg_t)) != 0)
255  {
256  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
257  }
258 
259  /* Compare openCfg->lowPowerMode*/
260  if(memcmp((void *)&gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.lowPowerMode, (void *)&openCfg.lowPowerMode,
261  sizeof(rlLowPowerModeCfg_t)) != 0)
262  {
263  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
264  }
265  /* Compare openCfg->adcOutCfg*/
266  if(memcmp((void *)&gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.adcOutCfg, (void *)&openCfg.adcOutCfg,
267  sizeof(rlAdcOutCfg_t)) != 0)
268  {
269  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
270  }
271  }
272 
273 
274 
275  /***********************************************************************************
276  * Retrieve mmwave Control related config before calling startSensor
277  ***********************************************************************************/
278  /* Get the mmWave ctrlCfg from the CLI mmWave Extension */
279  if(doReconfig)
280  {
281  /* if MmwDemo_openSensor has non-first time related processing, call here again*/
282  /* call sensor config */
283  CLI_getMMWaveExtensionConfig (&gMmwMssMCB.cfg.ctrlCfg);
284  retVal = MmwDemo_configSensor();
285  if(retVal != 0)
286  {
287  return -1;
288  }
289  }
290  retVal = MmwDemo_startSensor();
291  if(retVal != 0)
292  {
293  return -1;
294  }
295 
296  /***********************************************************************************
297  * Set the state
298  ***********************************************************************************/
299  gMmwMssMCB.sensorState = MmwDemo_SensorState_STARTED;
300  return 0;
301 }

318 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLISensorStop (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
319 {
320  if ((gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_STOPPED) ||
321  (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_INIT) ||
322  (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_OPENED))
323  {
324  CLI_write ("Ignored: Sensor is already stopped\r\n");
325  return 0;
326  }
327 
328  MmwDemo_stopSensor();
329 
330  gMmwMssMCB.sensorState = MmwDemo_SensorState_STOPPED;
331  return 0;
332 }

349 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLIGetSubframe (int32_t argc, char* argv[], int32_t expectedArgc,
350  int8_t* subFrameNum)
351 {
352  int8_t subframe;
353 
354  /* Sanity Check: Minimum argument check */
355  if (argc != expectedArgc)
356  {
357  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command\n");
358  return -1;
359  }
360 
361  /*Subframe info is always in position 1*/
362  subframe = (int8_t) atoi(argv[1]);
363 
364  if(subframe >= (int8_t)RL_MAX_SUBFRAMES)
365  {
366  CLI_write ("Error: Subframe number is invalid\n");
367  return -1;
368  }
369 
370  *subFrameNum = (int8_t)subframe;
371 
372  return 0;
373 }

475 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLICfarCfg (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
476 {
477  uint32_t procDirection;
478  int8_t subFrameNum;
479  float threshold;
480 
481  if(argc < 9)
482  {
483  return -1;
484  }
485  procDirection = (uint32_t) atoi (argv[2]);
486  threshold = (float) atof (argv[8]);
487 
488  if (threshold > 100.0)
489  {
490  CLI_write("Error: Maximum value for CFAR thresholdScale is 100.0 dB.\n");
491  return -1;
492  }
493 
494  /* threshold is a float value from 0-100dB. It needs to
495  be later converted to linear scale (conversion can only be done
496  when the number of virtual antennas is known) before passing it
497  to CFAR DPU.
498  For now, the threshold will be coded in a 16bit integer in the following
499  way:
500  suppose threshold is a float represented as XYZ.ABC
501  it will be saved as a 16bit integer XYZAB
502  that is, 2 decimal cases are saved.*/
503  threshold = threshold * MMWDEMO_CFAR_THRESHOLD_ENCODING_FACTOR;
504 
505  /* Save Configuration to use later */
506  if (procDirection == 0)
507  {
508  DPU_CFARProc_CfarCfg cfarCfg;
509 
510  if(MmwDemo_CLIGetSubframe(argc, argv, 13, &subFrameNum) < 0)
511  {
512  return -1;
513  }
514  /* Populate configuration: */
515  cfarCfg.averageMode = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[3]);
516  cfarCfg.winLen = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[4]);
517  cfarCfg.guardLen = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[5]);
518  cfarCfg.noiseDivShift = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[6]);
519  cfarCfg.cyclicMode = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[7]);
520  cfarCfg.thresholdScale = (uint16_t) threshold;
521  cfarCfg.peakGroupingEn = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[9]);
522  cfarCfg.osKvalue = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[10]);
523  cfarCfg.osEdgeKscaleEn = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[11]);
524  cfarCfg.isEnabled = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[12]);
525  MmwDemo_CfgUpdate((void *)&cfarCfg, MMWDEMO_CFARCFGRANGE_OFFSET,
526  sizeof(cfarCfg), subFrameNum);
527  }
528  else
529  {
530  DPU_DopplerProc_CfarCfg cfarCfg;
531 
532  if(MmwDemo_CLIGetSubframe(argc, argv, 14, &subFrameNum) < 0)
533  {
534  return -1;
535  }
536  /* Initialize configuration: */
537  memset ((void *)&cfarCfg, 0, sizeof(cfarCfg));
538  /* Populate configuration: */
539  cfarCfg.averageMode = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[3]);
540  cfarCfg.winLen = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[4]);
541  cfarCfg.guardLen = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[5]);
542  cfarCfg.noiseDivShift = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[6]);
543  cfarCfg.cyclicMode = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[7]);
544  cfarCfg.thresholdScale = (uint16_t) threshold;
545  cfarCfg.peakGroupingEn = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[9]);
546  cfarCfg.osKvalue = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[10]);
547  cfarCfg.osEdgeKscaleEn = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[11]);
548  cfarCfg.isEnabled = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[12]);
549  cfarCfg.variableThresholdMode = (uint8_t) atoi (argv[13]);
550  if(cfarCfg.isEnabled == 0){
551  CLI_write("Error: Doppler CFAR Cannot be disabled.\n");
552  }
553  MmwDemo_CfgUpdate((void *)&cfarCfg, MMWDEMO_CFARDOPPLERCFG_OFFSET,
554  sizeof(cfarCfg), subFrameNum);
555  }
556  return 0;
557 }

602  sizeof(compressionCfg), subFrameNum);

747 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLIDDMPhaseShiftOrder (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
748 {
749  uint8_t i = 0;
750 
751  /* Sanity Check: Minimum argument check */
752  if (argc < (1 + SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS))
753  {
754  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command\n");
755  return -1;
756  }
757

782 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLIAntGeometryCfg (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
783 {
785  uint32_t i=0, azimElemIdx=0, elevElemIdx = 0;
786  uint64_t zeroInsrtMaskAzim = 0, zeroInsrtMaskElev = 0;
787  Element antArr[MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT];
788  Element *elevAntArr = &antArr[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT];
789 
790  /* Sanity Check: Minimum argument check */
791  if (argc < (1 + MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT*2 + 2))
792  {
793  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command\n");
794  return -1;
795  }
796 
797  /* Assumption: row1: azimuth antenna array, row0: elevation antenna array */
798  for (i = 1; i < MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT * 2 + 1; i+=2) {
799  if(atoi(argv[i]) == 0)
800  {
801  if(elevElemIdx < MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT)
802  {
803  /* Elevation Antenna Sample */
804  antArr[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT + elevElemIdx].value = atoi(argv[i+1]);
805  antArr[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT + elevElemIdx].index = elevElemIdx;
806  elevElemIdx++;
807  }
808  else
809  {
810  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command. Assumption - Row1: Azimuth Array (12 elements), Row0: Elevation Array (4 elements) \n");
811  }
812  }
813  else if(atoi(argv[i]) == 1)
814  {
815  if(azimElemIdx < MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT)
816  {
817  /* Azimuth Antenna Sample */
818  antArr[azimElemIdx].value = atoi(argv[i+1]);
819  antArr[azimElemIdx].index = azimElemIdx;
820  azimElemIdx++;
821  }
822  else
823  {
824  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command. Assumption - Row1: Azimuth Array (12 elements), Row0: Elevation Array (4 elements) \n");
825  }
826  }
827  else
828  {
829  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command. Assumption - Row1: Azimuth Array (12 elements), Row0: Elevation Array (4 elements) \n");
830  return -1;
831  }
832  }
833 
834  /* Sort the azimuth array of structures based on value */
835  qsort(antArr, MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT, sizeof(antArr[0]), compare);
836 
837  /* Sort the elevation array of structures based on value */
838  qsort(elevAntArr, MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT, sizeof(elevAntArr[0]), compare);
839 
840  /* Store the rearrangement Order */
841  for (i = 0; i < MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT; i++)
842  {
843  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.antennaGeometryCfg[i] = (uint16_t) antArr[i].index;
844  }
845 
846  /* Find the zero insertion mask */
847  for(i=0; i < MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT; i++)
848  {
849  zeroInsrtMaskAzim |= (uint64_t)1 << antArr[i].value;
850  }
851  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskAzim = zeroInsrtMaskAzim;
852  /* Check the number of set bits in azimuth array zero insertion mask */
853  if(mathUtils_countSetBits(gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskAzim) != MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT)
854  {
855  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid input. Azimuth Zero Insertion Mask is incorrect. \n");
856  return -1;
857  }
858 
859  for(i=0; i<MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT; i++)
860  {
861  zeroInsrtMaskElev |= (uint64_t)1 << elevAntArr[i].value;
862  }
863  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev = zeroInsrtMaskElev;
864  /* Check the number of set bits in elevation array zero insertion mask */
865  if(mathUtils_countSetBits(gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev) != MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT)
866  {
867  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid input. Elevation Zero Insertion Mask is incorrect. \n");
868  return -1;
869  }
870 
871  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.antennaSpacing.xSpacingByLambda = \
872  atof(argv[MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT * 2 + 1]);
873  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.antennaSpacing.zSpacingByLambda = \
874  atof(argv[MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT * 2 + 2]);
875 
876  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.isAntennaGeometryCfgPending = 1;
877 
878  return 0;
879 }

896 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLIAntennaCalibParams (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
897 {
898 
900  float antennaCalibParams[SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL * SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS * 2];
901  int32_t argInd, i, j=0, idx;
902 
903  /* Sanity Check: Minimum argument check */
904  if (argc < (1 + SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS*SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL*2))
905  {
906  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command\n");
907  return -1;
908  }
909 
910  /* Initialize configuration: */
911  memset ((void *)&antennaCalibParams, 0, sizeof(antennaCalibParams));
912 
913  argInd = 1;
914  for (i = 0; i < SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS * SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL * 2; i++)
915  {
916  antennaCalibParams[i] = (float) atof (argv[i+argInd]);
917  }
918 
919  /* rearrange the antenna calibration parameters based on the antGeometryCfg */
920  if(gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.isAntennaGeometryCfgPending)
921  {
922  for (i = 0; i < SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS * SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL * 2; i+=2)
923  {
924  if (i < MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT * 2)
925  idx = 2*gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.antennaGeometryCfg[j++];
926  else
927  idx = 2*(MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT + gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.antennaGeometryCfg[j++]);
928  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.antennaCalibParams[i] = antennaCalibParams[idx];
929  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.antennaCalibParams[i+1] = antennaCalibParams[idx+1];
930  }
931  }
932  else
933  {
934  CLI_write ("Error: antGeometryCfg should be provided before antennaCalibParams.\n");
935  return -1;
936  }
937 
938  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.isAntennaCalibParamCfgPending = 1;
939 
940  return 0;
941 }

1269 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLIConfigDataPort (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
1270 {
1271  uint32_t baudrate;
1272  bool ackPing;
1273  uint8_t ackData[16];
1274  UART_Transaction trans;
1275 
1276  UART_Transaction_init(&trans);
1277 
1278  trans.buf = &ackData[0U];
1279  trans.count = sizeof(ackData);
1280 
1281  if (gMmwMssMCB.sensorState == MmwDemo_SensorState_STARTED)
1282  {
1283  CLI_write ("Ignored: This command is not allowed after sensor has started\n");
1284  return 0;
1285  }
1286 
1287  /* Populate configuration: */
1288  baudrate = (uint32_t) atoi(argv[1]);
1289  ackPing = (bool) atoi(argv[2]);
1290 
1291  /* check if requested value is less than max supported value */
1292  if (baudrate > MMWDEMO_DATAUART_MAX_BAUDRATE_SUPPORTED)
1293  {
1294  CLI_write ("Ignored: Invalid baud rate (%d) specified\n",baudrate);
1295  return 0;
1296  }
1297 
1298  UART_close(gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART1]);
1299  gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART1] = NULL;
1300 
1301  gUartParams[CONFIG_UART1].baudRate = (uint32_t) atoi(argv[1]);
1302 
1303  gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART1] = UART_open(CONFIG_UART1, &gUartParams[CONFIG_UART1]);
1304  if(NULL == gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART1])
1305  {
1306  DebugP_logError("UART open failed for instance %d !!!\r\n", CONFIG_UART1);
1307  return 0;
1308  }
1309 
1310  gMmwMssMCB.loggingUartHandle = gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART1];
1311 
1312  /* regardless of baud rate update, ack back to the host over this UART
1313  port if handle is valid and user has requested the ack back */
1314  if ((gMmwMssMCB.loggingUartHandle != NULL) && (ackPing == true))
1315  {
1316  memset(ackData,0xFF,sizeof(ackData));
1317  UART_write(gMmwMssMCB.loggingUartHandle, &trans);
1318  }
1319 
1320  return 0;
1321 }

1509 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLISSCConfig (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
1510 {
1511  /* Sanity Check: Minimum argument check */
1512  if (argc != 13)
1513  {
1514  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command\n");
1515  return -1;
1516  }
1517 
1518  /* Validate inputs */
1519  /* Modulation rate input */
1520  if (((bool) atoi(argv[1])) && (((uint32_t) atoi(argv[2]) == 0U) || ((uint32_t) atoi(argv[2]) > 100U)))
1521  {
1522  CLI_write ("Error: Core ADPLL modulation rate should be between 1KHz to 100KHz\r\n");
1523  return -1;
1524  }
1525 
1526  if (((bool) atoi(argv[5])) && (((uint32_t) atoi(argv[6]) == 0U) || ((uint32_t) atoi(argv[6]) > 100U)))
1527  {
1528  CLI_write ("Error: DSP ADPLL modulation rate should be between 1KHz to 100KHz\r\n");
1529  return -1;
1530  }
1531 
1532  if (((bool) atoi(argv[9])) && (((uint32_t) atoi(argv[10]) == 0U) || ((uint32_t) atoi(argv[10]) > 100U)))
1533  {
1534  CLI_write ("Error: PER ADPLL modulation rate should be between 1KHz to 100KHz\r\n");
1535  return -1;
1536  }
1537 
1538  /* Validate inputs */
1539  /* Modulation Depth input */
1540  if (((bool) atoi(argv[1])) && ((float) atof(argv[3]) > 2.0f))
1541  {
1542  CLI_write ("Error: Core ADPLL modulation depth should be between 0% to 2%\r\n");
1543  return -1;
1544  }
1545 
1546  if (((bool) atoi(argv[5])) && ((float) atof(argv[7]) > 2.0f))
1547  {
1548  CLI_write ("Error: DSP ADPLL modulation depth should be between 0% to 2%\r\n");
1549  return -1;
1550  }
1551 
1552  if (((bool) atoi(argv[9])) && ((float) atof(argv[11]) > 2.0f))
1553  {
1554  CLI_write ("Error: PER ADPLL modulation depth should be between 0% to 2%\r\n");
1555  return -1;
1556  }
1557 
1558  /* Populate configuration: CORE ADPLL SSC */
1559  gMmwMssMCB.coreAdpllSscCfg.isEnable = (bool) atoi(argv[1]);

1741 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLIAnalogTempRead (int32_t argc, char* argv[])

1776 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLIDigTempRead (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
1777 {
1778  int32_t status;
1779  GPADC_TempSensValueType tempValues = {0};
1780  uint8_t numAverageSamples = 5U;
1781 
1782  /* Initialize GPADC efuse parameter */
1783  GPADC_initTempMeasurement();
1784 
1785  status = GPADC_readTemperature(numAverageSamples,MAX_GPADC_TEMP_SENSORS, &tempValues);
1786 
1787  if(SystemP_SUCCESS == status)
1788  {
1789  CLI_write("Temperature read conversion successful\r\n");
1790  }
1791  else if(SystemP_FAILURE == status)
1792  {
1793  CLI_write("Temperature read conversion unsuccessful\r\n");
1794  }
1795 
1796  CLI_write("DSP = %d\r\nHWA = %d\r\nHSM = %d\r\n", tempValues.DigDspTempValue, tempValues.DigHwaTempValue, tempValues.DigHsmTempValue);
1797 
1798  return 0;
1799 }

1801 static int32_t MmwDemo_CLIADCDataDitherCfg (int32_t argc, char* argv[])
1802 {
1803  /* Sanity Check: Minimum argument check */
1804  if (argc != 3)
1805  {
1806  CLI_write ("Error: Invalid usage of the CLI command\n");
1807  return -1;
1808  }
1809 
1810  gMmwMssMCB.adcDataDithDelayCfg.isDitherEn = (bool) atoi (argv[1]);
1811 
1812  if(gMmwMssMCB.adcDataDithDelayCfg.isDitherEn)
1813  {
1814  /* Enable CSL_MSS_INTR_RSS_ADC_CAPTURE_COMPLETE_DITH interrupt */
1815  HwiP_enableInt((uint32_t)CSL_MSS_INTR_RSS_ADC_CAPTURE_COMPLETE_DITH);
1816 
1817  /* Convert the input dither from (us) to units of 3 Clock LSBs*/
1818  gMmwMssMCB.adcDataDithDelayCfg.ditherVal = (uint16_t)((atof(argv[2])/20.0)*1e3);
1819  if(gMmwMssMCB.adcDataDithDelayCfg.ditherVal == 0U)
1820  {
1821  CLI_write ("Error: Incorrect Dither Value. \n");
1822  return -1;
1823  }
1824  }
1825 
1826  return 0;
1827 }
